name: Acolyte
description: You have spent your life in service to a temple, learning sacred rites and providing sacrifices to gods.

name: Charlatan
description: You have a talent for deceptions, and you used it to make your way in the world.

name: Criminal
description: You are an experienced criminal with a history of breaking the law and surviving by your wits.

name: Entertainer
description: You thrive in front of an audience and know how to entrance, amuse, and inspire them.

name: Folk Hero
description: You come from a humble social rank, but you are destined for much more.

name: Guild Artisan
description: You are a member of an artisan guild, skilled in a particular field and closely associated with fellow artisans.

name: Hermit
description: You lived in seclusion for a formative period of your life, seeking solitude and contemplation.

name: Noble
description: You understand wealth, power, and privilege. You carry a noble title, and your family owns land and holds wealth.

name: Outlander
description: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilization and the comforts of town and technology.

name: Sage
description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse, scribing manuscripts and studying ancient texts.

name: Sailor
description: You sailed on a seagoing vessel for years, facing storms, monsters, and the sea.

name: Soldier
description: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember. You trained as a youth, studied tactics, and served in a army.

name: Urchin
description: You grew up on the streets alone, orphaned, and poor. You had no one to watch over you or to provide for you.
